A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same InvSR research work, with all 16 pages, supplementary sections A–B, seven tables, and nine figures available and readable. Text and visual comparisons support reliable matching throughout.

before.justification: v1 reports original super-resolution evaluations on ImageNet-Test, RealSR, and RealSet80, alongside sampling analyses, ablations, and runtime measurements in the supplementary material.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results, including benchmark comparisons, supplementary ablations, qualitative examples, and runtime measurements.

M1.justification: The noise predictor, partial noise prediction strategy, fixed diffusion backbone, training losses, and Algorithm 1 inference procedure are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions train on LSDIR and an FFHQ subset and evaluate ×4 super-resolution on ImageNet-Test, RealSR, and RealSet80. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain BSRGAN, RealESRGAN, LDM, StableSR, DiffBIR, SeeSR, ResShift, SinSR, and OSEDiff. Comparator membership in the supplementary backbone, ablation, and efficiency comparisons also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The evaluation samples, degradation procedures, seven quality metrics, sampling configurations, training settings, and A100 runtime protocol remain identical, including settings for supplementary experiments.

E4.justification: Table 1 retains the same sampling-step analysis. Supplementary sections B.1–B.3 retain the backbone comparison, intermediate-noise prediction ablation, and loss ablations; the blur-versus-noise examples also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–7 and qualitative result images are unchanged. For example, both report InvSR-1 ImageNet-Test PSNR of 24.14 in Table 2 and runtime of 117 ms in Table 7.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains the same equations (1)–(11), mathematical assumptions, and derivations motivating diffusion inversion and partial noise prediction. No formal result or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: diffusion inversion for super-resolution with a fixed backbone, flexible one-to-five-step sampling, and competitive one-step performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of fidelity–realism tradeoffs, noise amplification, backbone stability, and loss effects remain identical. Supplementary B.4 retains the efficiency limitation relative to GAN-based methods and the proposed future use of quantization.

D1.justification: Architecture details, optimizer settings, training budget, hyperparameters, hardware information, and code/model access information are unchanged. The supplementary material adds no new implementation or reproducibility disclosures.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 75 bibliography entries are unchanged. Positioning relative to prior diffusion inversion, diffusion-prior super-resolution, and fine-tuning approaches remains identical.

P1.justification: v2 adds Zongsheng Yue's Xi’an Jiaotong University affiliation, updates institutional address lines, removes the author email line, and adds an acknowledgement that the work was completed while he was with S-Lab. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 removes printed page numbers and makes small spacing or placement adjustments on the title page, acknowledgement/reference page, and supplementary opening page. All figures, tables, captions, and their scientific content remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revision updates affiliation and institutional provenance information and makes minor layout adjustments. The method, claims, experimental evidence, supplementary analyses, limitations, and reproducibility information are identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
